How to read this

Labor capacity value = (estimated minutes saved - review minutes) x assumed loaded hourly labor rate. ROI proxy is not cash ROI: time saved must be demonstrably redeployed or converted into avoided cost. Synthetic prices, wages, success rates, and time savings are scenario assumptions.
